description: This file defines structures, macros, and function declarations related to GST protection metadata, specifically for Rialto's media server component. It includes definitions for GstRialtoProtectionData and GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, as well as external references to GStreamer and Rialto-specific encryption/decryption services.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionData
classes.description: Structure holding protection metadata including session ID, buffers, cipher mode, and decryption service reference.

classes.name: _GstRialtoProtectionMetadata
classes.description: Structure combining GstMeta parent with GstRialtoProtectionData, representing protection metadata in GStreamer.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Function to get the GType for the protection metadata, used in GObject type system.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Function to retrieve metadata information for the protection metadata.
